# Studies in Economics and Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** SEF
- **Publisher:** Emerald Publishing
- **ISSN:** 1086-7376 / 1755-6791 (per researcher.life listing; portal.issn.org not checked — UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://www.emerald.com/sef
- **Author guidelines:** https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/journal/sef (journal page; exact author-guidelines URL UNVERIFIED)

## Scope
Per Emerald's reviewer-recruitment page for SEF: finance and the intersection of finance, financial markets and economics; "a premier outlet for high-quality empirical and theoretical research". Listed topics include asset management, derivatives, risk management, venture capital (finance); asset pricing, market efficiency, financial econometrics (financial markets); financial markets and economic growth (economics). A 2014 editorial records the shift of focus from economics towards finance.

## Scope Keywords
financial markets, asset pricing, market efficiency, financial econometrics, risk management, derivatives, asset management, empirical finance, financial economics

## Article Types Accepted
- Research paper (empirical and theoretical) — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.484; Finance Q2, Economics and Econometrics Q2, Economics, Econometrics and Finance (misc.) Q2 (scimagojr.com journal page, source id 11200153526)
- **Open Access:** Subscription/hybrid (optional Gold OA) — no mandatory APC found; journal-specific OA price UNVERIFIED
- **Field:** Finance / Financial economics

## Special Notes
Review speed (Emerald journal page, submissions 1 Apr 2024–31 Mar 2025): time to first decision 16 days; acceptance to publication 42 days; acceptance rate 5.7 %. Emerald states a goal of first decision within 60 days. AI policy (Emerald, publisher level): AI may be used to copy-edit the authors' own text with human review; generating new content (drafting any part of the submission) is not permitted; any AI use must be flagged in Methods/Acknowledgements and at submission; AI cannot be an author (Emerald publication-ethics page and May-2024 Emerald statement, as quoted in search extracts). Word limit UNVERIFIED.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** selective (published acceptance rate 5.7 %)
- **Desk-reject triggers:** UNVERIFIED (not stated in accessed text)
- **Study-type tolerance:** empirical and theoretical finance research
- **Review process:** peer review; first decision target 60 days
- **Cascade / transfer:** Emerald sister finance titles (Managerial Finance, Journal of Risk Finance, JCMS); formal transfer service UNVERIFIED
